title: Joseph's Dreams and Betrayal

questions.question: What special garment did Jacob give Joseph?
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:3 (ESV): "Now Israel loved Joseph more than any other of his sons...And he made him a robe of many colors."

questions.question: Why did Joseph's brothers hate him?
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:4: "But when his brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, they hated him."

questions.question: What did Joseph dream about sheaves?
options: His brothers' sheaves bowed to his
questions.correctAnswer: His brothers' sheaves bowed to his
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:7: "Your sheaves gathered around it and bowed down to my sheaf."

questions.question: What did Joseph's brothers do to him?
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:28: "They...sold him to the Ishmaelites for twenty shekels of silver."

questions.question: In his second dream, what bowed down to Joseph?
options: The sun, moon, and eleven stars
questions.correctAnswer: The sun, moon, and eleven stars
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:9: "The sun, the moon, and eleven stars were bowing down to me."

questions.question: Which brother suggested not killing Joseph?
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:21-22: "Reuben heard it and rescued him out of their hands, saying, 'Let us not take his life.'"

questions.question: What did the brothers do to deceive Jacob?
options: Dipped Joseph's robe in goat blood
questions.correctAnswer: Dipped Joseph's robe in goat blood
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:31: "They took Joseph's robe and slaughtered a goat and dipped the robe in the blood."

questions.question: How much was Joseph sold for?
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:28: "They...sold him to the Ishmaelites for twenty shekels of silver."

questions.question: Who bought Joseph in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:36: "The Midianites had sold him in Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh."

questions.question: Which brother proposed selling Joseph instead of killing him?
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:26-27: "Then Judah said...Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites."

questions.question: Where were the brothers pasturing when Joseph was sent to them?
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:12-17: Jacob sent Joseph to Shechem, but the brothers had moved to Dothan.

questions.question: Where did the brothers first throw Joseph?
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:24: "They took him and threw him into a pit. The pit was empty; there was no water in it."

questions.question: What was Potiphar's role?
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:36: "Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, the captain of the guard."

questions.question: How old was Joseph when he had his dreams?
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:2: "Joseph, being seventeen years old, was pasturing the flock with his brothers."

key_verse_text: They drew Joseph up and lifted him out of the pit, and sold him to the Ishmaelites for twenty shekels of silver.
